contracts.source: Constellation Energy press release: Constellation and CyrusOne Announce Agreement to Support New (02-09-2026)
contracts.signal: Calpine LLC, a Constellation business unit, signed a new 380-megawatt agreement with CyrusOne to connect and serve a new data center adjacent to the Freestone Energy Center (Freestone County, Texas), providing power, grid connectivity and site infrastructure; Calpine also entered into an exclusive agreement for Phase 2, an additional 380 MW. These come on top of the 400 MW Calpine-CyrusOne agreements for the Thad Hill Energy Center (Bosque County), for a total of over 1100 MW under contract for CyrusOne data centers in Texas.
contracts.units: 380 MW (Freestone) + 380 MW Phase 2 (exclusive) + 400 MW (Thad Hill); over 1100 MW in total
